displayDescription.en: End-to-end ops team for a hard-core finance Toutiao channel: data hunter, hard-core writer, and strict reviewer collaborate to deliver data-dense, sharp-style articles.
displayDescription.zh: 硬核财经头条号专属团队：数据采集、撰稿、严格审稿协同，输出数据密集、犀利、逻辑闭环的爆款。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 给我一个选题，我调度数据、撰稿、审稿三岗协同，把这篇稿子从立项到可发布完整跑通。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Give me a topic and I'll orchestrate data, writing, and review to ship a hard-core finance Toutiao article end-to-end.

quickPrompts.en: Give me a topic and I'll orchestrate data, writing, and review to ship a hard-core finance Toutiao article end-to-end.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我一个选题，我调度数据、撰稿、审稿三岗协同，把这篇稿子从立项到可发布完整跑通。

quickPrompts.en: Just hunt me the latest macro / industry / company data with a chart and source list.
quickPrompts.zh: 先帮我把最新宏观/行业/公司数据拉出来，附图、附来源、一句话解读。

quickPrompts.en: Run a strict review on this draft: fact-check, data-verify, compliance-check, style-calibrate.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我严格审这篇稿：事实核查、数据校核、合规审核、风格校准，四道关全跑。
